_comment: Claude Code MCP config for the Gaffer factory: the two data-plane MCP servers the agent delivers through. tick.sh renders a runtime copy, substituting ${DISPATCH_DB}/${MEMORY_DB} (runtime DB copies), ${DISPATCH_MCP_BIN}/${MEMORY_MCP_BIN} (the built dist bins), and ${GAFFER_CLAIM_TOKEN} (RUNNER-OWNED-BOOKKEEPING: the runner-held delivery claim token, so the agent's token-gated evidence writes resolve it from the server env — the agent never handles the token). The memory server additionally gets GAFFER_FACTORY=1 + ${GAFFER_TICKET_REPOS} (the ticket's in-scope repo names) so its DIRECT-APPLY writes (digest / feature) are bound to the ticket's repo scope, fail-closed, plus GAFFER_RECALL_TICKET (the delivery ticket ref) so its READ path can attribute a retrieval to a ticket for memory ROI (empty ⇒ inert, no logging). Build the workspace first: pnpm -r build.
